# "Day rate plus a hazmat fee" isn't a quote. It's a guess.

> Free calculator for biohazard and trauma-scene remediation technicians: price a job from crew labor, PPE decon cycles, and regulated-waste disposal billed per container (not per pound), then check whether a quote you're already giving clears cost.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
